PluginData.Author: SentorX
PluginData.Tooltip: Must-have utilities and administration tools for dedicated servers
PluginData.Description:
Sens Essentials is a collection of utilities and administration tools for Space Engineers dedicated servers.
- Auto Commands: run any command on a timer, at a time of day, at startup, on a vote, or at a grid count, player count or sim speed limit. - Cleanup and Block Presets: delete grids or switch blocks by conditions. - MOTD, and Info Commands players run with !info <name>. - Discord Logging: post all server plugin logs to webhooks. Off by default. - Suit Refill, and commands for grids, entities, teleporting, economy, voting, voxels, factions and identities.
On by default, under General: each player keeps 1 backpack, so older ones are deleted even with items in them (Backpack limit).
Configure it in Quasar under Server plugins. Guide: https://github.com/buttheadbob/SensEssentials Also available as a Torch plugin.
